title: Wonderful app to support incorporating habits the playful way
body:
In search of a way how I could improve my daily life, avoid being pulled into the grey-in-grey winter mood, I installed Finch one week ago. 
The app has outlived my expectations 😊 It’s very cute, easy to use and the annual fee for the subscription is absolutely fair 👍🏻 
You can choose from a wide range of little daily goals (sorted by category) but also, add your own goal (complete freedom). The whole layout idea is made in a way that encourages and allows you to remain flexible. There is no pressure to complete all goals, you can also snooze goals to a future date 📅 
I am a big fan of this app and am delighted to confirm that it has me excited every day to see how my little pet has grown further .. allowing me to grow by its side 🐦

title: Cute but expensive
body:
I actually really like the idea of Finch — it’s a cute and well-designed self-care app, and I was enjoying it so far.
However, I accidentally subscribed to the yearly plan and was immediately charged around €45. I honestly thought I still had one more day left on my trial, and now I feel really frustrated because that’s quite a lot of money for me.

While I take responsibility for the mistake, I do think there should be an easier way to cancel or undo an unintended purchase — especially for something that renews automatically. In my opinion, the yearly price doesn’t quite match the value I personally get from the app.

I hope the team might consider offering refunds or better reminders before charging. Otherwise, Finch is a lovely concept — just not worth that much for how I use it.

title: The best mental health and motivation app on the App Store, hands down 🙌
body:
I found this app by looking at a list of apps being made using Flutter, and this one caught my eyes in particular. I don’t want to get nerdy, but the custom UI widgets look amazing, there are some nice animations and the character design, including the art is definitely something that has to be appropriated. I think the best thing about the app is that you can feel that it was made with care and love, and I’ve been finding some small touches that keep amazing me.
Flinch inspired me to try to get out of my depression, and actually get to work on my goals and projects. Even though there might still be a long way to go, at least I feel like I’m making some progress. Also, now I’m kinda inspired to get back into studying Flutter!

title: fun AND useful
body:
this wonderful app
• helps you see how much you actually achieve in one day, so you feel more accomplished
• suggests easy to do social and intellectual activities 
• improves your overall mindset through gratitude and attention exercises
• can offer immediate help with mental stress (breathing exercises, soundscapes, panic exercises)
• keeps you checking in with the fun game aspect

recommended to those who want to
• improve their relationships to themselves and others
• become more productive and orderly
• manage their stress, depression, ADHD better

i have consistently been using finch app for the past months almost every single day. as a result, i have much improved my sleeping schedule, have become more relaxed an have better overall mood. i deal with stressful everyday situations better because of this.

my favorite features
• 'journeys' which let you set up recurring tasks
• suggested themed tasks, ex. for better sleep
• variety of soundscapes
• inclusive language and emojis
• very cute character design
• continuous updates

❤️ a big THANK YOU to the finch app team ❤️
